timeout.recommendation: Add context timeout (30s) for storage operations in artifact download/delete paths

retry.recommendation: Add retry with exponential backoff for transient storage errors (network timeouts, 503s)

circuit_breaker.recommendation: Consider circuit breaker for storage operations to prevent cascading failures during storage outages

bulkhead.recommendation: Not critical for artifact downloads as they are not high-frequency

fallback.behavior: DownloadArtifactV4ServeDirect falls back to DownloadArtifactV4ReadStorage if direct URL generation fails

idempotency.reason: Storage Delete is idempotent (deleting non-existent file is a no-op), reads are naturally idempotent

blast_radius.impact: Artifact downloads fail (ep-298), run deletion partially fails (logs/artifacts not cleaned from storage but DB records deleted)

findings.detail: Only DB queries, covered by DB connection pool timeouts
DB deletion is transactional but storage file deletion happens after transaction commit. If storage deletion fails, DB records are already gone but files remain orphaned.
findings.recommendation: Log orphaned files for manual cleanup or implement a reconciliation job

findings.detail: Storage.Delete calls in loop have no timeout
findings.recommendation: Add per-file timeout or overall operation timeout

non_atomic_operations: DB transaction deletes records, then storage files are deleted outside transaction - partial failure leaves orphaned storage files
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Storage outage causes slow/hanging delete requests but DB state is consistent
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Storage deletion failures are logged but don't fail the request (error is only logged)

findings.detail: SetArtifactNeedDeleteByID only updates WHERE status=UploadConfirmed, so repeated calls are safe (no-op after first)
Storage ServeDirectURL and Open operations have no explicit timeout

endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Falls back from ServeDirect to ReadStorage if presigned URL generation fails

health_checks.recommendation: Add dedicated readiness check that verifies storage connectivity

graceful_shutdown.detail: Gitea uses graceful.GetManager() for shutdown coordination

rate_limiting.detail: No rate limiting on artifact download endpoints
rate_limiting.recommendation: Consider rate limiting artifact downloads to prevent abuse

dead_letter_queues.detail: No async message processing in these endpoints

single_points_of_failure: Object storage backend - no redundancy or fallback if storage is unavailable
cascading_failure_paths: Storage outage → ep-298 download fails → CI/CD pipelines that depend on artifact downloads break
